title: Good practice
content: I have been with the practice for over 30 years and on the whole I've no complaints. Phoning in the morning is a nightmare, the same as most practices. However, I have found using the NHS app you can contact by email to ask a question etc, and receive a quick response, getting an appointment if necessary. Repeat prescriptions are quick and easy to do.
real_data_note: Verbatim real patient review (4-5 star), used as a positive practice exemplar for retrieval grounding. Not an authored policy document.
